pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sharp-edged polygonal geometry with high edge angularity. Patches on the flank are predominantly 4 to 6-sided with distinct vertices. Patches on the upper neck exhibit more elongated, quadrangular forms with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Tessellated negative-space graph of light-colored pelage. Primary nodes are trivalent (Y-junctions) and tetravalent (X-junctions). Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing significantly at the dorsal transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The mane consists of dense, upright hair clusters creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the sky/background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct dark avian-shaped silhouettes (Oxpeckers) attached to the pelage: one on the anterior lower neck, one on the mid-ventral flank, and one on the posterior lower flank.
